title: Live: Tens of thousands expected at Paris protests as unions join students
summary: Up to 40,000 people are expected to march in Paris on Tuesday as French trade unions join high school students protesting school conditions. The demonstrations have been marked by clashes with police, arrests, and injuries, including a 15-year-old student whose hand was blown off after he picked up a ‌police grenade.
